stem:
Ira draws a closed shape with three corner points P, Q and R joined by three straight sides.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: The shape is named only by one corner point, such as P.
The shape is a triangle even if one side is left open.
The shape is triangle PQR, with three sides and three angles at P, Q and R.
The shape is a triangle because the letter R is printed largest on the page.

teacher.key_rationale: A triangle is named by its three vertices and has three sides and three angles. One vertex alone is not the name. An open figure is not a triangle. Letter size is not the test.
